name: Client Chaos Playground 🖥️💥
desc:
Welcome to the Client Chaos Playground, where the rules are thrown out the window.

🎮 Run scripts through your executor and watch your creations replicate to everyone in real time!

🔓 No filters. No limits. Total client-side freedom.

✨ Make parts, spam effects, flex your script skills—or wreak hilarious havoc.

💡 Built for developers, scripters, and exploiters who want to see what client power can do when it’s fully unleashed.

⚠️ This place intentionally allows and encourages client-side script replication. Use at your own risk!
